id: Cornelia Parker Exhibition-City Gallery Wellington, Wellington, NZ-Ticket Master
name: Cornelia Parker Exhibition
long_description:
General Admission OnlyAll Tickets are Mobile Ticket Only. 
Mobile Tickets are like Print-at-Home tickets but instead of having to print off the tickets yourself, you can just show the barcode on your mobile phone. It is the easiest way to access tickets to your events. For more information visit Ticketmaster.co.nz/mobileticket

Child Policy: Children 4 years and under will be admitted free. General admission for ages 5-13 years will need a Child Ticket ($2)

Cornelia Parker is one of contemporary art's great alchemists-a master of metamorphosis and transformation; a maker of objects and encounters full of awe and wonder.

The exhibition brings Parker's recent projects into dialogue with her iconic works. It offers a rare opportunity to encounter the full scope of her practice: poetic, political, and relentlessly inventive. For more info click here(Opens in new tab)
